report.quality: You did a great job explaining the Transformer Architecture, saying, "It's about generating text using AI," which captures the core idea well. However, your description of Tokenization was a bit shaky; you mentioned, "it separated the words into vectors," but it would help to clarify what happens to the text before it becomes vectors.
recommendations: Re-explain «Tokenization»: say how the text is broken into pieces before the model reads it.
Explore «Prompt Engineering»: try to explain how you give instructions to the AI to get the desired response.
Discuss «Hallucinations»: describe what happens when the AI makes up information that isn't true.
report.summary: You've made great progress by covering the Transformer Architecture well! Keep up the good work; you're on your way to understanding these concepts!
